metadata.question: Did the area of open water around Bay Dosgris, south of New Orleans, increase from 1985 to 2024 relative to wetland areas?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
baydosgris = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-89.9, 29.1, -89.7, 29.3])
years = [1985, 2024]
results = {}

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
for year in years:
    # Get Landsat collections
    if year < 1999:
        col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(baydosgris).filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31')
    elif year < 2023:
        col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(baydosgris).filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31')
    else:
        col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').merge(
              ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')).filterBounds(baydosgris).filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31')
    
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"No data for {year}.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    
    # Apply scaling and cloud masking
    def process(img):
        qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
        cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0))
        scaled = img.select(['SR_B.', 'SR_B.']).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
        return scaled.updateMask(cloudMask)
    
    col = col.map(process)
    median = col.median()
    
    # Calculate indices
    mndwi = median.expression('(green - swir) / (green + swir)', {
        'green': median.select('SR_B2'),
        'swir': median.select('SR_B5')
    }).rename('mndwi')
    
    ndvi = median.expression('(nir - red) / (nir + red)', {
        'nir': median.select('SR_B4'),
        'red': median.select('SR_B3')
    }).rename('ndvi')
    
    # Calculate areas (km²)
    water = mndwi.gt(0)
    wetland = ndvi.gt(0.3)
    
    waterArea = water.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(1e6).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=baydosgris, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('mndwi').getInfo()
    wetlandArea = wetland.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(1e6).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=baydosgris, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('ndvi').getInfo()
    
    if waterArea is None or wetlandArea is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        exit()
    if waterArea == 0 and wetlandArea == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        exit()
    
    results[year] = waterArea / max(wetlandArea, 0.001)
    print(f"{year} Water: {waterArea:.2f}km², Wetland: {wetlandArea:.2f}km², Ratio: {results[year]:.3f}")

# 5. Final Answer
if results[2024] > results[1985]:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
